items.title_zh: 金警告恶意网络行为者正在不断演变策略

items.desc_en: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.
items.desc_zh: 费城警方表示，该提示被“标记为垃圾邮件”，但批评该科技公司花了两个多月的时间才发现并报告违规行为。
